Resolves #5085

Fixes `buildScripts/create/scss.mjs` to emit `:root .neo-${theme}` instead of `:root .${rootLowerCase}-${theme}` when generating theme SCSS stubs, so component theme files created for workspace/application namespaces (`LearnNeo.*`, `MyApp.*`) match the `:root .neo-theme-*` selector convention used across the repository.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suite `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createScss.spec.mjs` + `check-jsdoc-types.mjs`) → L2 required (unit-testable CLI SCSS generator behavior).

Micro-review eligible: mechanical-hygiene — 1-line template selector fix (`:root .${rootLowerCase}-${theme}` -> `:root .neo-${theme}`) in `buildScripts/create/scss.mjs` with unit regression spec.

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline unit tests and check-jsdoc-types ran`
